verdict.rationale: The evidence implies an official catalog exists: developer docs describe submitting apps to the Microsoft Store and packaging them as MSIX for distribution. However, nothing documents the user-side install experience or the catalog's size. missing for 10: evidence of the end-user install flow from the Store, evidence that the catalog holds thousands of apps, any power-user catalog tooling (e.g., command-line package installation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
